market_price_context.summary: Chennai dance class fees are commonly shown at ₹3,000 to ₹5,000 per month for regular batches, with a trial class at ₹500 and a one-time registration fee of ₹1,500.

UrbanPro search results and guide snippets for Chennai dance classes show examples such as ₹450 per hour and monthly fee ranges of ₹3,600 to ₹7,200 for 12 classes per month, with broader guide snippets also showing ₹300 to ₹600 hourly and ₹800 to ₹3,500 monthly.

Justdial listing snippets for Chennai dance classes indicate typical category pricing such as ₹1,000 per session for western dance classes for kids, ₹1,500 per session for teens/adults, and ₹2,000 per session for Zumba/dance fitness classes.
